title: Two-day smoothing of the ridge position (v8.4 and bf2.3; 2 trials)
model: ridge position on day d+1 = 0.5 x (prediction decided at the close of d + prediction decided at the close of d-1), times 0.5 as now; the book's current ridge otherwise unchanged
why: daily ridge predictions are noisy and turn over a lot (5 bp perps, larger CFD spreads); averaging two days halves the noise in the position and the turnover at little loss if the signal persists for more than a day
pass: v8.4: v-book bars (replace_ridge) + strict rule vs 2.750 / 1.324 / 3.896 / 2.428; bf2.3: bf2 bars + strict rule vs 2.506 / 0.313 / 3.985 / 2.298
